(371)༄༅/ /sems nyid rang grol gyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so/nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /sangs

tei:div.tei:p: sems nyid rang grol gyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// bdag dang 'gro drug gus pas bskyabs su mchi// sems bskyed pa ni/ mgon po sras dang bcas rnams dgongs// ji ltar dus gsum rgyal ba rnams// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyis shing*// ji ltar gsungs pa'i bslab pa dang*// rim pa bzhin du legs slob cing*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun bsal te// ci byas gzhan don 'grub par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ longs sku snang mtha' yab yum la gsol ba 'debs// āoṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma= /sprul sku o rgyan yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru= /rgyal sras dri med 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /mkhas grub bde legs rgya mtsho la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /bya btang ma ti maṃ sa la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /byang sems gu ṇa shrī la gsol ba= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /sprul sku bsam 'grub rgyal po la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /'khrul zhig nam mkha' gzhon nu la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /rgyal sras chos dbyings rdo rje la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /mkhas grub blo gros rgyal mtshan la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /bka' srung mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gsol ba 'debs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra (372)gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ bla ma rin po che bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa byang zhing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob nas tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes gangs can mtsho las lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin/ rgyal sras padma 'byung gnas kyi zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la dus gsum thams cad du phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// brtse ba chen po'i thugs rjes bzung du gsol// mgon po gdod nas rdzogs sangs rgyas// bde chen yon tan 'byung ba'i mdzod// sangs rgyas kun gyi bla ma mchog /kun bzang yab yum la phyag 'tshal// rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// zhi ba khro tshul dpag med ston// snang mtha' yab yum la phyag 'tshal// bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i rnam 'phrul las// rang byung ge sar padma'i steng*// mtshan rdzogs dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku// padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal// ngo bo ye nas kun tu bzang*// rang bzhin bde gshegs 'od dpag med// thugs rje padmar sku sprul pa// seng ge la phyag 'tshal// sku gsum mdzad pa'i phrin las kyis// gdul bya'i re ba rnam skong zhing*// mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba// padma rgyal po la phyag 'tshal// ji snyed ji bzhin thams cad mkhyen// sna tshogs chos kyi rnga sgra yis// bdud dang mu stegs tshar gcod pa// blo ldan mchog sred la phyag 'tshal// kun mkhyen ye shes gangs ri la// rnam grol mchog gi go 'phang brnyes// dpag med 'khor gyi tshogs nang du// (373)seng ge sgra sgrog la phyag 'tshal// thugs rje'i char sprin rol pa las// phan bde'i glog phreng char 'bebs shing*// 'gro blo'i phun tshogs rgyas byed pa// padma sambha la phyag 'tshal// mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong dkyil 'khor gyis// gsung rab padma rgyas mdzad cing*// 'gro ba'i lam yang dkar por mdzad// nyi ma 'od zer la phyag 'tshal// rnam 'phrul drag pos 'dul ba la// 'jigs rung gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhing*// lha srin gdug pa tshar gcod pa'i// padma thod phreng la phyag 'tshal// mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin phung las// dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing*// bde chen rgyal ba mnyes mdzad yum// mkhar chen 'tsho rgyal la phyag 'tshal// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rab gzigs shing*// dam chos rin chen mdzod 'dzin pa// zab mo'i dgongs gter rgyas mdzad pa// dri med 'od zer la phyag 'tshal// lta spyod zung du 'jug pa yis// rig 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// bla med snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin// bde legs rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal// bstan pa'i gdung 'dzin 'gro ba'i yab// rtogs pa phul phyin byang sems ldan// 'gro rnams smin grol lam la 'khod// ma ti maṃ ga la phyag 'tshal// sngon sbyong smon lam stobs chen gyis// stong nyid snying rje'i don rtogs nas// 'gro kun brtse bas 'dren pa'i dpal// gu ṇa shrī la phyag 'tshal// mdo rgyud dgongs pa thugs chud cing*// bslab gsum gyis brgyan rtogs pa 'bar// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po 'dzin// sprul sku bsam rgyal la phyag 'tshal// rnam grol chos dbyings mnyam nyid dang*// zag med (374)ye shes 'od gsal mchog

/nyin dang mtshan mor dbyer med pa'i// nam mkha' gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal// gdod nas lhun grub chos sku'i ngang*// gzugs sku rol pa sgyu ma'i sku// sna tshogs thabs ldan 'gro kun sgrol// mkha' klong yangs pa la phyag 'tshal// stong nyid zab mo'i 'od nyid las// mi shes rang blo'i bcings pa kun// ye shes rig pa'i ral gris gcod// ma ti dhwa dza la phyag 'tshal// sngon sbyangs stobs chen las 'phro yis// bla med rdo rje snying po'i don// 'bad rtsol yid bar lhun gyis grub// rtsa ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal// rang nyid chos dbyings rol pa las// sna tshogs thabs kyi rnam 'phrul gyis// phrin las rnam bzhi'i las mdzad pa// mkha' 'gro dam can la phyag 'tshal// gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rigs 'dzin dang*// bde gshegs chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho dang*// mchod 'os kun la bdag phyag 'tshal// dge'o//
